ayahs.textUthmani: حمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حمٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.[1458]
ayahs.translationClear: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۙۛ
ayahs.translation: By the clear Book,
ayahs.translationClear: By the Enlightening Scripture.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ‌ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ فِيْ لَيْلَةٍ مُّبٰرَكَةٍ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.[1459] Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee laylatim mubaarakatin innaa kunnaa mundhireen

footnotes.1459: The Night of Decree (Qadr). See Sūrah al-Qadr.

ayahs.translationClear: We have revealed it on a Blessed Night—We have warned.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ حَكِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct[1460] every precise matter -

footnotes.1460: Or "is separated" or "apportioned," from what is inscribed in the Preserved Slate. The angels record and descend with whatever Allāh has decreed for the coming year.

ayahs.translationClear: In it is distinguished every wise command.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ‌ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْرًا مِّنْ عِنْدِنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.translationClear: A decree from Us. We have been sending messages.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
ayahs.translationClear: As mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ‌ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۘ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
ayahs.translationClear: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you know for sure.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ‌ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيٖ وَيُمِيْتُؕ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ اٰبَا࢜ىِٕكُمُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu aabaa'ikumul-awwaleen
ayahs.translationClear: There is no god but He. He gives life and causes death—your Lord and Lord of your ancestors of old.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ يَّلْعَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
ayahs.translationClear: Yet they play around in doubt.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَاْتِي السَّمَا࢜ءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
ayahs.translationClear: So watch out for the Day when the sky produces a visible smoke.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّغْشَي النَّاسَؕ هٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
ayahs.translationClear: Enveloping mankind; this is a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
ayahs.translationClear: “Our Lord, lift the torment from us, we are believers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنّٰي لَهُمُ الذِّكْرٰي وَقَدْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: Annaa lahumudh-dhikraa waqad jaa'ahum rasoolum mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: But how can they be reminded? An enlightening messenger has already come to them.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوْا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُوْنٌ ۘ
ayahs.translation: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
ayahs.translationClear: But they turned away from him, and said, “Educated, but crazy!”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا‌ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا كَاشِفُوا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ عَا࢜ىِٕدُوْنَ ۘ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
ayahs.translationClear: We will ease the punishment a little, but you will revert.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرٰيۚ اِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when We launch the Great Assault—We will avenge.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَا࢜ءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ كَرِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wajaa'ahum rasoolun kareem
ayahs.translationClear: Before them We tested the people of Pharaoh; a noble messenger came to them.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَنْ اَدُّوْٓا اِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِيْنٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.[1461] Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
ayahs.transliteration: An addoo ilayya 'ibaadallaahi innee lakum rasoolun ameen
ayahs.translationClear: Saying, “Hand over Allah’s servants to me. I am an honest messenger to you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاَنْ لَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيْٓ اٰتِيْكُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'al laa ta'loo 'alallaahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And, “Do not exalt yourselves above Allah. I come to you with clear authority.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنِّيْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّيْ وَرَبِّكُمْ اَنْ تَرْجُمُوْنِ ؗ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.[1462]

footnotes.1462: To death. Or "lest you assault me [with your tongues or harm me otherwise]."

ayahs.translationClear: I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ لَّمْ تُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْا لِيْ فَاعْتَزِلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
ayahs.translationClear: But if you do not believe in me, keep away from me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗٓ اَنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
ayahs.transliteration: Fada'aa rabbahoo anna haa'ulaa'i qawmum mujrimoon
ayahs.translationClear: He appealed to his Lord: “These are a sinful people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْ لَيْلًا اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
ayahs.translationClear: “Set out with My servants by night—you will be followed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا‌ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًاؕ اِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And leave the sea in stillness.[1463] Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

footnotes.1463: After it has parted, in order that the soldiers of Pharaoh would follow the Children of Israel and be drowned.

ayahs.translationClear: And cross the sea quickly; they are an army to be drowned.”

ayahs.textUthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: كَمْ تَرَكُوْا مِنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.translationClear: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّزُرُوْعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.translationClear: And plantations, and splendid buildings.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْا فِيْهَا فٰكِهِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And comfort wherein they were amused.
ayahs.translationClear: And comforts they used to enjoy.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ‌ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَاَوْرَثْنٰهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
ayahs.translationClear: So it was; and We passed it on to another people.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَا࢜ءُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْا مُنْظَرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa bakat 'alayhimus-samaa'u wal-ardu wamaa kaanoo munzareen
ayahs.translationClear: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِيْنِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
ayahs.translationClear: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating persecution.

ayahs.textUthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
ayahs.translationClear: From Pharaoh. He was a transgressing tyrant.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنٰهُمْ عَلٰي عِلْمٍ عَلَي الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
ayahs.translationClear: And We chose them knowingly over all other people.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الْاٰيٰتِ مَا فِيْهِ بَلٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ٌا مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aataynaahum minal-aayaati maa feehi balaa'um mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And We gave them many signs, in which was an obvious test.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ لَيَقُوْلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
ayahs.translationClear: These people say.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْاُوْلٰي وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.transliteration: In hiya illaa mawtatunal-oolaa wamaa nahnu bimunshareen
ayahs.translationClear: “There is nothing but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاْتُوْا بِاٰبَا࢜ىِٕنَا͏ٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.translationClear: Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ‌ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَهُمْ خَيْرٌ اَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۙ وَّالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْؗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا مُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ[1464] and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'in wal-ladheena min qablihim ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen
ayahs.translationClear: Are they better, or the people of Tubba and those before them? We annihilated them. They were evildoers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
ayahs.translationClear: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا خَلَقْنٰهُمَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa khalaqnaahumaa illaa bil-haqqi walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: We created them only for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيْقَاتُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
ayahs.translationClear: The Day of Sorting Out is the appointed time for them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِيْ مَوْلًي عَنْ مَّوْلًي شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day when no relation[1465] will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shay'an walaa hum yunsaroon

footnotes.1465: i.e., patron, protector or close associate.

ayahs.translationClear: The Day when no friend will avail a friend in any way, and they will not be helped.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنْ رَّحِمَ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.translationClear: Except for him upon whom Allah has mercy. He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
ayahs.translationClear: The Tree of Bitterness.

ayahs.textUthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: طَعَامُ الْاَثِيْمِ ۚۖۛ
ayahs.translation: Is food for the sinful.
ayahs.translationClear: The food of the sinner.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: كَالْمُهْلِۚۛ يَغْلِيْ فِي الْبُطُوْنِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.translationClear: Like molten lead; boiling inside the bellies.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: Like the boiling of scalding water.
ayahs.translationClear: Like the boiling of seething water.

ayahs.textUthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: خُذُوْهُ فَاعْتِلُوْهُ اِلٰي سَوَا࢜ءِ الْجَحِيْمِ ࣗۖ
ayahs.translation: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
ayahs.translationClear: Seize him and drag him into the midst of Hell!

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ صُبُّوْا فَوْقَ رَاْسِهٖ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيْمِ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
ayahs.translationClear: Then pour over his head the suffering of the Inferno!

ayahs.textUthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ذُقْۚۙ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْكَرِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble![1466]

footnotes.1466: As he had claimed upon the earth. He is taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder and additional torment.

ayahs.translationClear: Taste! You who were powerful and noble.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haadhaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon
ayahs.translationClear: This is what you used to doubt.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ مَقَامٍ اَمِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
ayahs.translationClear: As for the righteous, they will be in a secure place.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ۚۙ
ayahs.translation: Within gardens and springs,
ayahs.translationClear: Amidst gardens and springs.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَّلْبَسُوْنَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ ۚۙ
ayahs.translation: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
ayahs.translationClear: Dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَࣞ وَزَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِيْنٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.translationClear: So it is, and We will wed them to lovely companions.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يَدْعُوْنَ فِيْهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
ayahs.translationClear: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ‌ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَذُوْقُوْنَ فِيْهَا الْمَوْتَ اِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْاُوْلٰيۚ وَوَقٰىهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.translationClear: Therein they will not taste death, beyond the first death; and He will protect them from the torment of Hell.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
ayahs.translationClear: A favor from your Lord. That is the supreme salvation.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
ayahs.translationClear: We made it easy in your language, so that they may remember.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَارْتَقِبْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّرْتَقِبُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
ayahs.translationClear: So wait and watch. They too are waiting and watching.
